nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Defines Tauri IPC command handlers for CRUD operations on agent definitions and agent orgs (teams), including tool-state introspection, patch-based updates, builtin reset, and integrations config access.

nodes.name: agent_definitions_list_all
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists all agent definitions currently registered in the definitions store, returning them as wire-format DTOs for the frontend.

nodes.name: agent_definitions_remove
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes an agent definition by id from the store and cleans up any org references, propagating the change to running sessions.

nodes.name: agent_org_run_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists recent org/team run summaries (InboxRunSummary) for display in the frontend inbox, capped to a limit.

nodes.name: agent_def_tool_states
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes the enabled/disabled state of every tool for a given agent definition, returning AgentToolStateRow entries for the tool-configuration UI.

nodes.name: agent_def_update_patch
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies an AgentDefinitionPatch to an existing agent definition and persists the resulting override.

nodes.name: agent_def_reset_builtin
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resets a builtin agent definition back to its default configuration, discarding any user overrides.

nodes.name: integrations_update_patch
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies a partial patch to the integrations configuration (web search, nodes, execution mode, etc.) and persists it.

nodes.name: InboxRunSummary
nodes.summary: Wire DTO summarizing a single org/team run (status, timing, participants) for the inbox/run-history UI.

nodes.name: AgentToolStateRow
nodes.summary: Wire DTO representing whether a specific tool is enabled for an agent definition, used to render the tool-configuration table.

nodes.name: microcompact.rs
nodes.summary: Implements lightweight 'microcompaction' that clears stale tool results and caps recent tool-call images to keep context size under a rolling token budget without a full LLM summarization pass.

nodes.name: evaluate_time_trigger
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a time-based microcompaction trigger should fire based on elapsed time and configured thresholds.

nodes.name: microcompact_messages
nodes.summary: Runs a microcompaction pass over the message list, clearing stale tool results and capping images per the configured budget.

nodes.name: force_microcompact_messages
nodes.summary: Forces a microcompaction pass regardless of normal trigger conditions, used for explicit/manual invocation.

nodes.name: clear_old_tool_results
nodes.summary: Clears the content of old tool-call results that fall outside the retention window, replacing them with lightweight placeholders to reduce token usage.

nodes.name: cap_recent_tool_images
nodes.summary: Caps the number/size of images retained in recent tool-call results to control image-heavy context bloat.

nodes.name: enforce_aggregate_budget
nodes.summary: Enforces an aggregate token budget across all tool results by progressively clearing older entries until under budget.

nodes.name: enforce_group_budget
nodes.summary: Enforces a per-group token budget on a specific subset of tool-result message indices.

nodes.name: MicrocompactConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the microcompaction feature (thresholds, retention windows), with defaults.

nodes.name: MicrocompactStats
nodes.summary: Statistics produced by a microcompaction pass (e.g., messages cleared, tokens saved).

nodes.name: ReplacementState
nodes.summary: Tracks which tool-result entries have already been cleared/replaced during microcompaction, to avoid re-processing.

nodes.name: compact.rs
nodes.summary: Implements session-memory-aware compaction (try_sm_compact) that computes a safe message-keep index around existing compact-boundary markers and API tool-call invariants.

nodes.name: try_sm_compact
nodes.summary: Attempts session-memory-aware compaction: computes a safe keep index relative to prior compact boundaries and returns the resulting compacted message set.

nodes.name: parse_compact_boundary_content
nodes.summary: Parses the structured content of a compact-boundary marker message to recover its metadata.

nodes.name: parse_compacted_count
nodes.summary: Parses the count of previously-compacted messages from a compact-boundary header string.

nodes.name: compact_boundary_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw text of a compact-boundary marker from a message, if present.

nodes.name: calculate_messages_to_keep_index
nodes.summary: Calculates the message index boundary marking which messages should be kept (not re-summarized) during session-memory compaction.

nodes.name: adjust_keep_index_for_api_invariants
nodes.summary: Adjusts a candidate keep-index so it doesn't split a tool-call/tool-result pair, keeping the resulting message list API-valid.

nodes.name: is_text_message
nodes.summary: Checks whether a message consists purely of text content (no tool calls/results).

nodes.name: last_turn_has_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Checks whether the most recent conversational turn contains tool calls, used to decide safe compaction boundaries.

nodes.name: ParsedCompactBoundary
nodes.summary: Parsed representation of a compact-boundary marker's metadata (e.g., compacted message count, timestamp).

nodes.name: patch.rs
nodes.summary: Defines partial-update patch types (AgentPolicyPatch, SessionModelPatch, AgentToolSelectionPatch, AgentDefinitionPatch) with apply() methods that merge optional overrides onto an existing agent definition, gated by builtin-agent restrictions.

nodes.name: AgentPolicyPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for AgentPolicy fields (e.g., autonomy level, risk rules), applied on top of an existing policy via apply().

nodes.name: SessionModelPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for the SessionModel (LLM provider/model selection) fields, merged onto an existing session model via apply().

nodes.name: AgentToolSelectionPatch
nodes.summary: Partial-update patch for an agent's tool selection/allow-deny configuration, merged via apply().

nodes.name: AgentDefinitionPatch
nodes.summary: Top-level partial-update patch aggregating policy, model, and tool-selection patches for an AgentDefinition, with builtin-agent gating (gate_for_builtin) and an apply() that merges all sub-patches.

nodes.name: sections.rs
nodes.summary: Analyzes session-memory section sizes against token budgets, generates section-size reminders, and truncates/flushes oversized sections.

nodes.name: analyze_section_sizes
nodes.summary: Parses session-memory content into named sections and estimates the token size of each.

nodes.name: generate_section_reminders
nodes.summary: Generates reminder text flagging session-memory sections that exceed their configured token budgets.

nodes.name: truncate_for_compact
nodes.summary: Truncates session-memory content down to fit within a per-section token budget ahead of compaction.

nodes.name: flush_section
nodes.summary: Flushes an accumulated section's lines into a bounded-length text block under a header, splitting or truncating as needed.

nodes.name: SmSection
nodes.summary: Represents a single named section of session-memory content along with its accumulated lines/size.

nodes.name: exec_modes.rs
nodes.summary: Defines security policy layers and system-prompt suffixes per execution mode (e.g., read-only), including the base set of denied tools.

nodes.name: read_only_deny_base
nodes.summary: Returns the base set of tools denied under read-only execution mode.

nodes.name: policy_layer
nodes.summary: Builds the security-policy layer (deny/ask rules) associated with the current execution mode.

nodes.name: system_prompt_suffix
nodes.summary: Builds the system-prompt suffix text describing the active execution mode's constraints, appended to the agent's system prompt.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the model_context subsystem, re-exporting cleanup, compaction, file_reinjection, microcompact, plan_preservation, session_memory, summarization, and tokenizer.

nodes.name: gateway_pipeline.rs
nodes.summary: Implements process_gateway_message, the central pipeline function that routes and processes incoming gateway messages for a session.

nodes.name: process_gateway_message
nodes.summary: Central pipeline function that processes an incoming gateway message for a session -- dispatching by message type, handling IDE context and image attachments, and driving the appropriate session-state updates.

nodes.name: tests_extended.rs
nodes.summary: Extended unit test suite for the definitions subsystem covering store, resolver, patch, and orgs behaviors.
